blocks.label: pool-allocated node factory
blocks.py:
store = []                            # object pool as list
free = []                              # free-index stack
def alloc(val):
    if free: i = free.pop(); store[i].val = val
    else: store.append(Node(val)); i = len(store)-1
    return i
def release(i): free.append(i)         # dangling-index hygiene on caller

blocks.md: Sorted structure answering map/set queries with EXPECTED O(log n) using coin-flip tower heights. Search: sprint express lanes, drop down when overshooting. Insert: random height ~geometric(1/2). No rotations ever — probabilistic balance replaces AVL machinery.

steps: Each node promoted upward with probability p=1/2 per level
Search starts TOP lane, walks right while ≤ target, drops a level otherwise
Expected hops per level ≈ 1/p ⇒ Θ(log n) total

revisionCard: Lists win ONLY at pointer-surgery ops; cache tax elsewhere
erase-returns-next = safe walk; splice = O(1) range teleport
Josephus: ring simulation ↔ O(n) recurrence dual-check
Index-pool nodes kill new/delete storms; dangling-index hygiene
Skip list = coin-flip towers, Θ(log n) expected, rotation-free
LRU via list.splice + iterator map — production-grade variant
Structure-selection defense (ops frequency) is the real interview deliverable
